domain.name: Social Emotional Development Standard
domain.description: Social emotional development is the core of early care and education because it sets a firm foundation on which all other learning will take place.

sub_strand.name: Self-Awareness
sub_strand.description: The child demonstrates an awareness of self. Children develop a sense of personal identity as they begin to recognize the characteristics that make them unique as individuals and to build self-esteem.

indicator.name: Demonstrates self-confidence
indicator.description: Acknowledges her own accomplishments and says, "I can hit the ball." Explains, "I'm learning how to take care of myself and my friends." Signs, "I can do it myself."

indicators.source_text:
Demonstrates self-confidence.
a.
Acknowledges her own accomplishments and says, "I can hit the ball."
Explains, "I'm learning how to take care of myself and my friends."
Signs, "I can do it myself."
